join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat add <name> <delay in seconds> [message difference]

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat add <name> <delay in seconds> [message difference]

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600 10
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will now repeat every 600 seconds if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will now repeat every 600 seconds if at least 2 messages have passed.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 29
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Delay must be at least 30 seconds.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Delay must be at least 30 seconds.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme -3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Delay must be at least 30 seconds.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat add <name> <delay in seconds> [message difference]


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Message difference must be at least 1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600 -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Message difference must be at least 1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600 huh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !repeat add <name> <delay in seconds> [message difference]


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command addb repeatme2 Hello there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' added, restricted to broadcasters and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 modman/2 access=moderator :!repeat add repeatme2 30
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme2' is restricted to broadcasters; only broadcasters and above can modify its repeat.
